state.meaning: TRUE requires all five clauses PASS. FALSE is produced by an executed governing FAIL or UNKNOWN (clause 5 violated; the literal text: a structural UNKNOWN is a valid executed result that forces FALSE). None exists. While any clause is INCOMPLETE and none is violated, the value is NOT EVALUABLE: it is NOT TRUE, and it is not (yet) FALSE.
